author: Veli Raiya
title: Fantasy book map designer and character illustrator wanted
content: Looking for a fantasy book map designer + character illustrator! Definitely does not have to be the same artist for both. Bonus points if you are a fantasy author recommending someone you have personally worked with. See the next posts for more details. For character art, gravitates toward realistic, epic fantasy concept art rather than cartoon illustration; book is lighter fantasy but wants grounded, lifelike art; open to styles; bonus for POC and a wide variety of ethnicities. For the map, wants something detailed and immersive with a classic fantasy-map feel, open stylistically. Contact: reply on the thread or DM @veliraiyawrites. Still receiving artist replies; no close notice.

author: blekek.k
title: Illustrators wanted for trading card project
content: Hi warga threads! We're looking for illustrators for our little trading card project. Whether you draw professionally, as a hobby, are still a student, or already work full-time, feel free to reach out. Looking for artists that draw anime/manga, cartoon/semi-cartoon, Pokemon / One Piece / MTG TCG artwork, semi-realistic, and other styles. Comment if interested or DM directly. Follow-up: thanks for reaching out; checking portfolios; send a link to previous works if not yet sent. Contact: comment or DM @blekek.k.
